title: Reference Mapping Products
description: This procurement procedure aims at the establishment of a multiple framework contract with reopening of competition with a maximum of seven selected tenderers, covering the production of reference mapping products that will facilitate the assessment of specific areas of interest in support of EU decision-making. The FWC will cover the production and delivery of five different types of products: Product 1 - Full Reference Mapping: High Resolution Vector Data (HRVD) products and provision of a background of geographical context, as well as a representation of a requested AOI, including hydrography, topography, land cover, infrastructure and population relevant data according to a Reference Mapping Data Dictionary (RMDD). The Full Reference Mapping encompasses 212 Feature Classes (Area: 105, Line: 43, Point: 64). Product 2 - Reduced Reference Mapping: HRVD products and provision of a background of geographical context, as well as a representation of a requested AOI, including lines of communications, land cover and other relevant data according to a subset of the RMDD. The Reduced Reference Mapping Product encompasses 117 Feature Classes (Area: 60, Line: 28, Point: 29). Product 3 - On-Demand Reference Mapping: HRVD products and provision of background of geographical context, as well as a representation of a requested AOI, with a limited set of Feature Classes which will be defined in each specific Product Request Form. Product 4 - Updated Reference Mapping: Updates of HRVD products that have already been produced, based on new extraction specifications as well as new imagery. Product 5 – Situational Mapping: HRVD product representing a requested AOI and a given set of limited and defined Feature Classes, compiled and delivered in a map book format. All of the aforementioned products will also require capabilities in processing Very High Resolution optical satellite imagery to create mapping-ready orthomosaics and open source information extraction to accurately complete the attribute tables of some features.

title: NON-DESTRUCTIVE VERIFICATION OF THERMAL INTERFACES IN AMBIENT CONDITION - EXPRO PLUS
description: Support reduction in cost and time for telecom satellite testing by facilitating reliable ambientverification of thermal interface conductance.DescriptionConsidering the tendency to move towards ambient testing, rather than vacuum testing, for recurringflight models, there is a need to reliably verify the workmanship of key characteristics of the thermalcontrol system in ambient conditions. One of these critical parameters is the thermal conductanceof interfaces between dissipative equipment and radiators/heat pipes. One way to approach thisproblem is to look for out of family behaviour, or by comparison with past tests. However, this onlyworks when reference data is available and therefore a more general way to actually "measure" thethermal conductance of the interface in ambient is highly desirable.The activity investigates the best non-destructive testing techniques that could be used to verify thermal interfaces in ambient conditions. A physical test matrix would then be executed to assess the performance of the chosen method(s) for different equipment, fillers, and mounting substrates.This will involve both vacuum and ambient testing to gain confidence in the accuracy of the chosentechniques.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Requirements consolidation- State of the art review and selection of best measurement technique- Elaboration and manufacturing of test matrix (coupons)- Execution of the tests- Final reporting and roadmap for industrialisation.

title: Servicii de transmisie date ce asigura suportul realizarii managementului activitatii de pescuit
description: Agenția Națională pentru Pescuit și Acvacultură a achiziționat recent noi echipamente de comunicații de tip transponder satelit și GSM, echipamente necesare pentru actualizarea componentei de comunicații ce asigură suportul realizării managementului de pescuit. Soluția are la bază echipamentele RockFLEET/YB3i – IRIDIUM DEVICES (VESSEL MONITORING SYSTEMS) produse de compania engleză Rock Seven Mobile Service Limited. Astfel, în vederea atingerii obiectivelor stabilite prin Regulamentul UE nr. 508/2014 al Parlamentului European și al Consiliului din 15 mai 2014 privind Fondul european pentru pescuit şi afaceri maritime, respectiv art. 76, Control și executare, se impune achiziționarea de noi Servicii de transmisii de date care să asigure continuitatea în transmiterea de date dinspre actorii implicați în activitățile de pescuit și de comercializare a produselor pescărești spre autoritățile relevante ale statelor membre și ale Uniuni și trasabilitatea produselor pescărești și de acvacultură. Cerinte pentru serviciile de transmisie date 1. Servicii de transmisie date VMS Se vor achizitiona servicii de transmisie a datelor VMS de la transpondere către CMP. Prin utilizarea unui format specific, datele VMS primite pot fi interpretate automat de catre CMP. Pe baza acestora CMP poate bloca/debloca accesul la datele legate de un anumit vas pentru alte tari. Aceasta informatie va fi utilizata pentru trimiterea automata a anumitor mesaje pe baza criteriilor reglementate. Cu ajutorul datelor va fi posibila vizualizarea flotei active, gestionarea zonelor de pescuit cu acces restrictionat, vizualizarea datelor privind capturile si detectarea activitatilor de pescuit nedeclarate si nereglememntate. Aceste servicii vor include minim transmiterea a 24 pozitii/zi/nava. 2. Servicii de transmisie date ERS Se vor achizitiona servicii de tip abonament. CMP existent poate prelua date atat de la transponderele existente, cat si de la altele noi ce vor fi furnizate. Datele se vor folosi pentru o supraveghere permanenta a vaselor de pescuit. Se vor putea customiza alerte pentru a sprijini activitatea de monitorizare a pescuitului. Se vor recepționa date de longitudine, latitudine, viteza si cursul urmat de o nava. Datele vor fi procesate pentru a ajuta la conservarea stocurilor de peste si de a le gestiona intr-un mod durabil economic. Vor fi transmise rapoartele de captura zilnice precum si rapoartele celorlalte operatii de pescuit (plecare, intrare in zona, debarcare, etc) in mod grupat, pe voiaje de pescuit. Aplicatia de la bordul navelor prezinta formularele de introducere de date pre-completate cu datele deja disponibile, prin utilizarea parametrilor configurabili, ale informatiilor GPS, ale datei si timpului curent. Serviciile oferite vor fi în regim 24h pe zi, 7 zile din 7. Suportul tehnic include analizarea problemelor notificate de către beneficiar precum și prioritizarea acestora după un grad de severitate. Achiziția implică încheierea unui acord cadru și se va derula începând cu data semnării lui având o durata de 24 de luni. Cantitati minime/maxime acord cadru: - minim – 68 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS; - maxim – 80 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS. Cantitati minime/maxime contract subsecvent: - minim – 68 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS; - maxim – 80 abonamente de transmisie date de tip ERS/VMS. Achiziţionarea produselor care fac obiectul prezentei achiziţii publice se va face fără a depăşi limita maximă a întregii cantităţi indicate în acordul cadru. Nr de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 8 zile Termenul-limita in care AC va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare: in a 3-a zi înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor

Ks. myös tarjouspyynnön liitteenä A olevan puitesopimuksen kohta 6. Hankintasopimukset voivat olla voimassa yhden (1) vuoden puitesopimuksen päättymisen jälkeen. PUITEJÄRJESTELYN LAAJUUS Puitejärjestelyn arvioitu arvo on 5 000 000 - 6 600 000 euroa (alv 0 %) sisältäen myös optiokauden. Puitejärjestelyn enimmäisarvo on 6 600 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Hankintojen euromääräisen arvon määrittämistä vaikeuttaa osaltaan se, että puitejärjestelyyn liittyneiden Asiakkaiden hankintoihin alustavasti myönnettyihin varoihin voi puitesopimuskaudella tulla ennakoimattomia, Asiakkaasta riippumattomia muutoksia. Luvut perustuvat liittyneiden asiakkaiden antamiin tietoihin puitejärjestelyn käytöstä.

title: LISA-ITT-069 Payload Hoisting MGSE
description:
The gravitational wave observatory LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) has been selected as ESA’s third large class mission (L-3) within the Cosmic Vision programme. LISA’s mission objective is to observe gravitational waves from space in the frequency band of 0.1 mHz to 1 Hz, not accessible from ground-based observatories. 
The mission architecture consists of a constellation of three spacecraft placed at the vertexes of a near-equilateral triangle with side length of about 2.5 million km (LISA Constellation). An overview of the LISA mission and its objectives can be found on the Agency website here: https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/LISA
OHB, prime contractor for the programme, has been contracted by the European Space Agency (ESA) for the realization of the LISA programme, building the industrial consortium.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the LISA Payload Hoisting MGSE.
The LISA Payload Hoisting MGSE shall provide multiple hoisting GSEs for flexible and safe handling of different LISA Payload sub-assemblies during AIT activities. The MGSEs will be used under ISO 5 cleanliness conditions and in direct contact with high performance optical instruments. Therefore, the GSEs shall ensure full instrument safety, and special care shall be taken in the selection of materials to comply with the magnetic cleanliness requirements of the LISA project.
The procurement of the LISA Payload Hoisting MGSE will be conducted in line with the “ESA Best Practices for the Selection of Subcontractors by Prime Contractors in the frame of ESA’s Major Procurements. Additional requirements on geo-return may be specified in the ITT data package.
